notes: The R cancel is written at Medium confidence: the kit flags Rite of the Arcane as an interruptible channel and Riot's text has Xerath immobilise himself to cast it, so Pop Blossom's knockup and stun should cancel it. I did NOT claim that Tangle-Barbs' root cancels it — a root does not stop a stationary channel and nothing in the kit settles it (listed in unverified). The content-layer chart was already correct and matches packet.levelChart; the full layer was seven rows of 'Skill' and is fixed to match. Ratings left untouched — the rating scale is not self-consistent across matchups, so I could not tell which direction a change should move. breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and 'ahead' remain templated; Xerath's kit gives nothing specific enough to reground them without inventing.
